description: This file defines a Kotlin class `CategoryChipAdapter` which extends `ListAdapter` to render category chips in a RecyclerView, including handling selection state, customizing appearance, and managing data updates.

classes.name: CategoryChipAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for rendering category chips with selection capabilities in a RecyclerView.

classes.name: CategoryChipAdapter.Item
classes.description: Data class representing each category chip, including id, label, optional category value, and selection state.

classes.name: CategoryChipAdapter.VH
classes.description: ViewHolder class for binding category chip data to the UI components.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds an Item object to the ViewHolder, setting label, icon, accessibility content description, and click listener.

methods.name: dpToPx
methods.description: Converts density-independent pixels (dp) to pixels based on the device resources.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and inflates a new ViewHolder instance.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the ViewHolder at a specific position.

methods.name: submitCategories
methods.description: Public method to create and submit the list of category items, including a special 'All' item, marking the selected category.
